examples.chinese: 我要喝珍珠奶茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
examples.english: I want to have bubble milk tea.

examples.chinese: 我想喝珍珠奶茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
examples.english: I want to have bubble milk tea.

examples.chinese: 台灣的珍珠奶茶怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de zhēnzhū nǎichá zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: How about Taiwan’s bubble milk tea?

examples.chinese: 我要一杯珍珠奶茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào yì bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá.
examples.english: I would like to have a cup of bubble milk tea.

examples.chinese: 我的女朋友很喜歡喝珍珠奶茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ péngyǒu hěn xǐhuān hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
examples.english: My girlfriend likes bubble milk tea very much.

items.wordHook: 奶(milk) + 茶(tea) → 奶茶(milk tea).

examples.chinese: 今天是五月十七日，星期一。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǔ yuè shíqī rì, xīngqí yī.
examples.english: Today is Monday, May 17th.

examples.chinese: A：你今天早上有課嗎？ B：我今天早上沒有課。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma? B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méi yǒu kè.
examples.english: A: Do you have class this morning? B: I don’t have class this morning.

examples.chinese: 今天是星期一，你不去學校嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqí yī, nǐ bú qù xuéxiào ma?
examples.english: It is Monday today; aren’t you going to school?

examples.chinese: 中明今天很累。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngmíng jīntiān hěn lèi.
examples.english: Zhongming is very tired today.

examples.chinese: 你今天要做什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān yào zuò shénme?
examples.english: What do you want to do today?

examples.chinese: 我今天七點起床。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: I get up at 7:00 today.

examples.chinese: 他今天不來學校嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān bù lái xuéxiào ma?
examples.english: Isn’t he coming to school today?

examples.chinese: 啊！今天是你的生日。生日快樂！
examples.pinyin: Ā! Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì. Shēngrì kuàilè!
examples.english: Ah! It is your birthday today. Happy birthday!

examples.chinese: 今天是星期五，明天是週末，你們要不要來我家？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqí wǔ, míngtiān shì zhōumò, nǐmen yào bú yào lái wǒ jiā?
examples.english: Today is Friday and it is the weekend tomorrow. Do you want to come to my place?

examples.chinese: 你今天要買什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān yào mǎi shénme?
examples.english: What would you like to buy today?

examples.chinese: 我今天晚上要去同學家玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang yào qù tóngxué jiā wán.
examples.english: I am going to hang out with my classmate at his/her place tonight.

examples.chinese: 他今天很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: He is very happy today.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣好熱。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hǎo rè.
examples.english: The weather is so hot today.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，我們去海邊曬太陽吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù hǎibiān shài tàiyáng ba.
examples.english: The weather is nice today. Let’s go to the beach to get some sun!

examples.chinese: 今天我去朋友家玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ qù péngyǒu jiā wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: I had fun at my friend’s place today.

examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，海邊的風景也很漂亮，我想去游泳，妳們想去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, hǎibiān de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliàng, wǒ xiǎng qù yóuyǒng, nǐmen xiǎng qù ma?
examples.english: The weather is pretty good today, so is the view at the beach. I want to go swimming. Do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 老師，國安今天要請假。他發燒了，不能來上課。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, Guó'ān jīntiān yào qǐngjià. Tā fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè.
examples.english: Teacher, Guoan has to take a leave today. He has a fever and he can’t come to school.

examples.chinese: 國安跟我說，他今天要去看醫生，他家附近有一家不錯的醫院。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān gēn wǒ shuō, tā jīntiān yào qù kàn yīshēng, tā jiā fùjìn yǒu yì jiā búcuò de yīyuàn.
examples.english: Guoan told me he is going to see a doctor today; there is a nice hospital near his place.

examples.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，我的同學國安也感冒了，今天開始發燒了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, wǒ de tóngxué Guó'ān yě gǎnmào le, jīntiān kāishǐ fāshāo le.
examples.english: Many people got colds lately. My classmate, Guoan, got a cold, too. He started to have a fever today.

examples.chinese: 今天我要帶一些水果去看他，也會跟他說今天的功課。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ yào dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn tā, yě huì gēn tā shuō jīntiān de gōngkè.
examples.english: Today, I am going to take some fruit to visit him and also inform him about the homework today.

items.wordHook: 今(current) + 天(day) → today, the current day.

examples.chinese: 紅色的花、白色的花都很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Hóngsè de huā, báisè de huā, dōu hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: Red and white flowers are both beautiful.

examples.chinese: A：你喜歡紅色的筆嗎？ B：我喜歡白的。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xǐhuān hóngsè de bǐ ma? B: Wǒ xǐhuān bái de.
examples.english: A: Do you like red pens? B: I like white pens.

examples.chinese: 紅色、白色都好看。
examples.pinyin: Hóngsè, báisè, dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Red and white are both good.

examples.chinese: 李小姐的錢包是紅色的。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě de qiánbāo shì hóngsè de.
examples.english: Miss Li’s purse is red.

examples.chinese: 請問兩位要紅茶還是綠茶？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn liǎng wèi yào hóngchá háishì lǜchá?
examples.english: Would you like to have black tea or green tea?

examples.chinese: 我要紅茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào hóngchá.
examples.english: Black tea please.

examples.chinese: 請給我們一杯紅茶、一杯綠茶。請問一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒmen yì bēi hóngchá, yì bēi lǜchá. Qǐngwèn yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: We would to have a cup of black tea and a cup of green tea. How much does that cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 我家附近有三條捷運線，一條紅的、一條綠的和一條藍的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu sān tiáo jiéyùn xiàn, yì tiáo hóng de, yì tiáo lǜ de hé yì tiáo lán de.
examples.english: There are three MRT routes near my place; the red one, the green one and the blue one.

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

items.wordHook: a 糹(silk) takes the 工(work) dye → a wedding banner of 紅(red).

examples.chinese: 這個蛋糕跟這瓶果汁一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dàngāo gēn zhè píng guǒzhī yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do this cake and this bottle of juice cost?

examples.chinese: 我要買一張桌子跟四張椅子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn sì zhāng yǐzi.
examples.english: I want to buy one table and four chairs.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽有一個哥哥跟兩個妹妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma yǒu yí ge gēge gēn liǎng ge mèimei.
examples.english: My mom has an elder brother and two younger sisters.

examples.chinese: 我旁邊有日本同學，前面跟後面都有美國同學。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ pángbiān yǒu Rìběn tóngxué, qiánmiàn gēn hòumiàn dōu yǒu Měiguó tóngxué.
examples.english: There are Japanese classmates beside me, and there are American classmates in front and behind.

examples.chinese: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is neither on the sofa, under the sofa, nor beside the sofa. Mom, could you find it for me?

examples.chinese: 媽，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的錢包不在房間裡。
examples.pinyin: Mā, wǒ gēn Yǒuměi yào qù hē xiàwǔ chá, kěshì wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: Mom, Youmei and I are going to have afternoon tea now, but my wallet is not in the bedroom.

examples.chinese: 我跟同學常常一起在學校打網球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué chángcháng yìqǐ zài xuéxiào dǎ wǎngqiú.
examples.english: My classmates and I often play tennis together at the school.

examples.chinese: 我跟媽媽明天下午要一起去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn māma míngtiān xiàwǔ yào yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: Mom and I are going to see a movie tomorrow afternoon.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

examples.chinese: 好。我先回宿舍做功課，再跟你一起去找他。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo. Wǒ xiān huí sùshè zuò gōngkè, zài gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Okay. I will go back to the dormitory to do my homework first, then I will go to see him with you.

examples.chinese: 我們班只能禮拜一跟禮拜二下午用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān zhǐ néng lǐbài yī gēn lǐbài èr xiàwǔ yòng.
examples.english: Our class can only use it in the afternoon on Mondays and Tuesdays.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 國安跟我說，他今天要去看醫生，他家附近有一家不錯的醫院。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān gēn wǒ shuō, tā jīntiān yào qù kàn yīshēng, tā jiā fùjìn yǒu yì jiā búcuò de yīyuàn.
examples.english: Guoan told me he is going to see a doctor today; there is a nice hospital near his place.

examples.chinese: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
examples.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

examples.chinese: 他打電話跟我說，他不能來上課，請我幫他請假。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà gēn wǒ shuō, tā bù néng lái shàngkè, qǐng wǒ bāng tā qǐngjià.
examples.english: He gave me a call and told me that he couldn’t make it to class and asked me to ask for a leave for him.

examples.chinese: 今天我要帶一些水果去看他，也會跟他說今天的功課。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ yào dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn tā, yě huì gēn tā shuō jīntiān de gōngkè.
examples.english: Today, I am going to take some fruit to visit him and also inform him about the homework today.

examples.chinese: 原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點兒不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎnr bù yíyàng.
examples.english: It turns out that the Vietnamese zodiac animals are a little bit different from the Chinese ones.

examples.chinese: 知道，友美跟我講過。
examples.pinyin: Zhīdào, Yǒuměi gēn wǒ jiǎng guò.
examples.english: Yes, Youmei told me already.

examples.chinese: 這個星期六是元宵節，妳跟友美會去看燈會嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīngqī liù shì Yuánxiāojié, nǐ gēn Yǒuměi huì qù kàn dēnghuì ma?
examples.english: This Saturday is the Lantern Festival. Will you and Youmei go to see the Lantern Carnival?

items.wordHook: a 口(gate) says 止(stop) to the tough 艮(mountain) pressing on your 跟(heel).

examples.chinese: 我媽媽有一個哥哥跟兩個妹妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma yǒu yí ge gēge gēn liǎng ge mèimei.
examples.english: My mom has an elder brother and two younger sisters.

examples.chinese: 那不是我的，是哥哥的。我的錢包不在客廳裡。
examples.pinyin: Nà bú shì wǒ de, shì gēge de. Wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài kètīng lǐ.
examples.english: It is not mine. It is my elder brother’s. Mine is not in the living room.

examples.chinese: 哥哥喜歡在床上看書。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐhuān zài chuáng shàng kànshū.
examples.english: My elder brother likes to read in bed.

items.wordHook: 哥(elder brother), said twice: 哥哥(elder brother).

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，我們去海邊曬太陽吧。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù hǎibiān shài tàiyáng ba.
examples.english: The weather is nice today. Let’s go to the beach to get some sun!

items.wordHook: 曬(dry in the sun) + 太陽(the sun) → drying yourself under the sun: 曬太陽(to bask in the sun).

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 我們班只能禮拜一跟禮拜二下午用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān zhǐ néng lǐbài yī gēn lǐbài èr xiàwǔ yòng.
examples.english: Our class can only use it in the afternoon on Mondays and Tuesdays.

examples.chinese: 華人用不一樣的動物代表每一年，一共有十二種動物。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng bù yíyàng de dòngwù dàibiǎo měi yì nián, yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù.
examples.english: Chinese use different animals to represent each year, and there are a total of twelve kinds of animals.

items.wordHook: Inside a 冂(frame) sit 二(two) bars → grab them to 用(use).

examples.chinese: 老闆今天帶我去參觀了一家工廠。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn jīntiān dài wǒ qù cānguān le yì jiā gōngchǎng.
examples.english: The boss took me to visit a factory today.

examples.chinese: 朋友推薦我去參觀這裡有名的博物館。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou tuījiàn wǒ qù cānguān zhèlǐ yǒumíng de bówùguǎn.
examples.english: A friend recommended that I visit the famous museum here.

examples.chinese: 這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān. 2. Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english: 1. This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting. 2. The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The travel itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as sightseeing, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 小溫規劃的旅遊行程，有參觀、購物、看表演等活動，我相信大家會很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wēn guīhuà de lǚyóu xíngchéng, yǒu cānguān, gòuwù, kàn biǎoyǎn děng huódòng, wǒ xiāngxìn dàjiā huì hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The tour itinerary planned by Xiao Wen includes activities such as visiting, shopping, and watching performances; I believe everyone will be very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 這個旅行團的目的地是中國北京(Beijing)，旅客目的是參觀古蹟及拜訪朋友。
花蓮太魯閣的確很漂亮，難怪每年都吸引許多觀光客去參觀。
我們特地到當地的滑雪用品工廠參觀，並進行技術交流。
我們公司在這次電子展共發表了九項新產品，並吸引不少國外客戶來參觀。
這家博物館曾因戰爭而被破壞，如今總算重新開放參觀。

items.wordHook: 參(take part) + 觀(observe) → taking part in looking around: 參觀(to visit).

examples.chinese: 學校的網站上有很多學生寫的文章。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de wǎngzhàn shàng yǒu hěn duō xuéshēng xiě de wénzhāng.
examples.english: On the school's website there are many articles written by students.

examples.chinese: 這個網站上的圖片很多，而且都很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhàn shàng de túpiàn hěn duō, érqiě dōu hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: There are many pictures on this website, and they all look great.

examples.chinese: 有一些交友網站上的個人姓名、年齡等資料都是假的，所以上網交友要小心。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē jiāoyǒu wǎngzhàn shàng de gèrén xìngmíng, niánlíng děng zīliào dōu shì jiǎ de, suǒyǐ shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Some personal information such as names and ages on dating websites is false, so you need to be careful when making friends online.

examples.chinese: 透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, wǒmen kěyǐ jiārù gǎn xìngqù de shètuán, ràng zìjǐ de shēnghuó gèng chōngshí.
examples.english: Through social media, we can join clubs we are interested in, making our lives more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 一般購物網站都是等收到顧客的匯款後，才寄出商品的。
在臺灣鐵路局的網站訂票，一人最多只能訂六張搭車當天的票。
購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
你想參加這項長跑比賽的話，可以到網站報名，登記之後會有人跟你聯絡。
那個網站在拍賣手工肥皂，買一送一，蠻划算的。
我們往前走，很快就到公園了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wǎng qián zǒu, hěn kuài jiù dào gōngyuán le.
examples.english: We walk forward, and we will soon arrive at the park.

examples.chinese: 這個公園裡有幾棵又高又大的樹。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge gōngyuán lǐ yǒu jǐ kē yòu gāo yòu dà de shù.
examples.english: In this park there are several tall and big trees.

examples.chinese: 每天早上公園裡都有很多人在運動，非常熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang gōngyuán lǐ dōu yǒu hěn duō rén zài yùndòng, fēicháng rènao.
examples.english: Every morning in the park there are many people exercising, it is very lively.

examples.chinese: 公園的音樂晚會快要開始了，可不可以請你們幫我排那些椅子？
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán de yīnyuè wǎnhuì kuài yào kāishǐ le, kě bù kěyǐ qǐng nǐmen bāng wǒ pái nàxiē yǐzi?
examples.english: The park's music evening party is about to start; could you please help me line up those chairs?

examples.chinese: 那三個孩子手拉著手，一起去公園玩。
examples.pinyin: Nà sān ge háizi shǒu lā zhe shǒu, yīqǐ qù gōngyuán wán.
examples.english: Those three children, holding hands, went to the park to play together.

examples.chinese: 我在公園散步的時候，聞到了花的香味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài gōngyuán sànbù de shíhou, wén dào le huā de xiāngwèi.
examples.english: When I was taking a walk in the park, I smelled the fragrance of flowers.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"雨停了，我們可以去公園野餐了。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這座停車場很大，可以停五百輛汽車。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le, wǒmen kěyǐ qù gōngyuán yěcān le. | Zhè zuò tíngchēchǎng hěn dà, kěyǐ tíng wǔbǎi liàng qìchē.
examples.english: The rain has stopped; we can go to the park for a picnic. | This parking lot is very big; it can park five hundred cars.

examples.chinese: 夏天的晚上，我喜歡去公園散散步、吹吹風。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de wǎnshang, wǒ xǐhuan qù gōngyuán sànsanbù, chuīchuifēng.
examples.english: On summer evenings, I like to go to the park for a walk and to enjoy the breeze.

examples.chinese: 我不太喜歡流很多汗，所以不常跑步，比較喜歡在公園散步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān liú hěn duō hàn, suǒyǐ bù cháng pǎobù, bǐjiào xǐhuān zài gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: I don't really like to sweat a lot, so I don't run often; I prefer to take walks in the park.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: 公園附近的停車場還很空，你可以把車停到那裡去。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán fùjìn de tíngchēchǎng hái hěn kōng, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng dào nàlǐ qù.
examples.english: The parking lot near the park is still very empty; you can park your car there.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 我坐在公園裡看著花兒隨著風搖擺，那個樣子真是可愛極了。
我買了海洋公園的門票，打算利用週末帶孩子一起去逛逛。
每天早上都有人在附近公園大聲唱流行歌，聽久了真的很煩。
考完試以後，我們去海洋公園開開心心地玩一場吧。
我喜歡陪家人到公園的草地上野餐，氣氛溫暖又歡喜。

items.wordHook: 公(public) + 園(garden) → a public garden, a park.

examples.chinese: 哥哥洗澡以後都先喝一瓶牛奶再睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐzǎo yǐhòu dōu xiān hē yì píng niúnǎi zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: After my older brother takes a shower, he always first drinks a bottle of milk and then goes to sleep.

examples.chinese: 爸爸下班以後，總是先洗個澡、喝個飲料，再吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Bàba xiàbān yǐhòu, zǒngshì xiān xǐ ge zǎo, hē ge yǐnliào, zài chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After work, Dad always first takes a shower, has a drink, and then eats dinner.

items.wordHook: 洗(wash) + 澡(bathe) → washing the body: 洗澡 means to take a bath.

examples.chinese: 這家咖啡館有免費的無線網路，我可以邊喝咖啡邊上網。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēiguǎn yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù, wǒ kěyǐ biān hē kāfēi biān shàngwǎng.
examples.english: This café has free Wi-Fi; I can drink coffee while surfing the internet.

examples.chinese: 有了無線網路，就可以隨時隨地上網查資料、看影片，或是玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le wúxiàn wǎnglù, jiù kěyǐ suíshísuídì shàngwǎng chá zīliào, kàn yǐngpiàn, huòshì wán yóuxì.
examples.english: With wireless internet, you can go online anytime, anywhere to look up information, watch videos, or play games.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese: 國際棒球比賽快開始了，那一群剛入棒球場、穿藍色運動服的就是臺灣隊。
媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。
examples.pinyin: Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.
examples.english: My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results.

examples.chinese: 為了在這場鋼琴演奏中有優秀的表現，小戴早晚不停地練習。
那家店正在推銷巧克力口味的小籠包，我們要不要去嘗試一下？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zhèngzài tuīxiāo qiǎokèlì kǒuwèi de xiǎolóngbāo, wǒmen yào bù yào qù chángshì yīxià?
examples.english: That shop is promoting chocolate-flavored soup dumplings; shall we go try them?

examples.chinese: 有的父母讓孩子嘗試打工，是為了讓孩子更加獨立。
他第一次嘗試滑雪，跌了好幾次，好不容易才學會。
天天說自己外行、不願嘗試的人，就無法更深入地瞭解世界。

items.wordHook: Combining 嘗(taste) and 試(try): 嘗試 means try.

examples.chinese: 父母做人做事的態度，對孩子會產生極大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ zuòrén zuòshì de tàidù, duì háizi huì chǎnshēng jí dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Parents' attitudes toward how they conduct themselves and handle matters will produce a tremendous influence on their children.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 人類活動產生許多垃圾，不但汙染了環境，更改變了全球氣候。
汽車的汽油燃燒不完全的話，容易產生很多廢氣。
水和冰基本上是相同的，只是因溫度而產生不同的變化。
根據氣象資料，這個颱風未來兩天會往西移動，週五起對台灣產生影響。
當森林漸漸從地球上消失時，可能使全球氣候產生重大的變化。
解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
章先生念國小時，父親帶著他上山下海、到處旅遊，那是屬於他們的美好記憶。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng niàn guóxiǎo shí, fùqīn dàizhe tā shàngshān xiàhǎi, dàochù lǚyóu, nà shì shǔyú tāmen de měihǎo jìyì.
examples.english: When Mr. Zhang was in elementary school, his father took him up mountains and across seas, traveling everywhere; that is a beautiful memory belonging to them.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上一醒來就去刷牙、洗臉，然後去附近國小的操場跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang yì xǐnglái jiù qù shuāyá, xǐliǎn, ránhòu qù fùjìn guóxiǎo de cāochǎng pǎobù.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as I wake up, I go brush my teeth and wash my face, and then I go running on the playground of the nearby elementary school.

examples.chinese: 連先生很年輕的時候就當了國小校長，當年他才三十歲。
examples.pinyin: Lián xiānsheng hěn niánqīng de shíhou jiù dāng le guóxiǎo xiàozhǎng, dāngnián tā cái sānshí suì.
examples.english: Mr. Lian became an elementary school principal when he was very young; in those days he was only thirty years old.

examples.chinese: 春假時我打算到泰國小島上的鄉村去度個假。
以前人們常用磁帶來存電腦的重要資料。
到國外旅遊時身上別攜帶太多鈔票，否則錢丟了就麻煩了。
有些運動中心規定個人得帶自己的毛巾，否則不可以進去。
除非別人願意，否則你不該強迫其他人全按你的意見做事。
想小便的時候千萬別忍耐，否則對健康的影響相當大。
這個角色一直找不到合適的演員，幸好那位明星點頭答應演出，否則影片就拍不成了。
我昨天割草時沒戴帽子，整張臉都因為陽光太強而變紅了。
我曾經在賣精油的商店服務過一段時間。
他透過古典文學來討論古代與現代的文化差異。
解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
對任何人的態度，不該因種族、國籍或性別而不同。

items.wordHook: Each 夂(go) takes its own 口(mouth) along → 各(individual).
Combining 外(out) and 公(public): 外公 means grandfather mother's side.
Combining 天(sky) and 真(real): 天真 means innocent.
Combining 底(bottom) and 下(below): 底下 means the area beneath.
然(so) + 後(after) → 'so, after that': 然後 means afterward.
She knots a 糹(silk) thread around a 勺(spoon) and waits → a firm 約(appointment).
Using a sharp 金(gold) chisel to 彔(carve wood) historical archives preserves an enduring 錄(record).
